themes.Republican Primary Campaign Dynamics:
Meaning: Related during the election to his republican opponents during the primary as well as specific reactions to debated. 
Include: During the presidential era, this should generalize to broad criticism of other republicans or former allies. 
Exclude: criticism of other opponents such as democrats
Examples and boundaries: "Marco Rubio is totally weak on illegal immigration &amp, in favor of easy amnesty. A lightweight choker - bad for #USA!"
themes.Immigration Reform and Nationalism:
Meaning: Immigration reform is realted to any attack on Hispanic Migrants, proposed law changes, an all things related to the border wall. Nationalism associated with Donald Trump (often tied to his "America First" platform and the broader Trumpism and MAGA movement) centers on prioritizing national sovereignty, protectionist trade, and strict immigration controls over globalist frameworks
Include: Any MAGA or RNC slogans fit the nationalism flag.
Exclude: tweets that do not mention immigration, border security, nationalism, MAGA
Examples and boundaries: Flashback – Jeb Bush says  illegal immigrants breaking our laws is an “act of love” http://t.co/p8yFzVuw8w He will never secure the border.
themes.Campaign Rallies and Support in Key Stat:
Meaning: During the election he promoted early reporting states (e.g., Iowa) heavily. 
Include: This will generalize to his continued rally's during his presidential term. 
Exclude: Discussion of events that are not political rallies / campaign events / promotional for his policies
Examples and boundaries: I will be in Indiana on Sunday and Monday at four MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN rallies. See you there!
themes.Criticism of Political Opponents:
Meaning: Attacks and critique of all percieved opponents 
Include: Obama, Clinton, the media, Bush, Biden, China
Exclude: When he is not attacking or directing at opponents. 
Examples and boundaries: "Crooked Hillary Clinton made up facts about me, and ""forgot"" to mention the many problems of our country, in her very average scream!"
themes.Media Appearances and Personal Life High:
Meaning: Largely promoting his media appearances and his family members
Include: Content related to self promotion, personal brand, etc.
Exclude: Irrelevant updates that are not promo or praise
Examples and boundaries: I will be interviewed on @foxandfriends tomorrow morning at 7:00. Enjoy!
themes.Terrorism, National Security Concerns, a:
Meaning: Largely national security concerns related to the Middle East and Immigration at the southern border. A lot of this was associated with criticizing the Obama Administration
Include: When Terrorism, national security, and Obama's foreign policy is mentioned
Exclude: topics related to domestic / social issues
Examples and boundaries: Hillary won't call out radical Islam! She will be soundly defeated.
themes.Expressions of Gratitude and Positivity:
Meaning: This is a very broad and general theme that includes a lot of "follow up" messages following media spots, as well as shout outs.
Include: Positivity, thanksgiving, praise
Exclude: angry content, attacks, etc.
Examples and boundaries: HAPPY NEW YEAR &amp, THANK YOU!
themes.Tax and Healthcare Policy:
Meaning: Theme is largely focused on his personal taxes, the Clinton's taxes, Obamacare, and other tax or healthcare policy. 
Include: taxes, tax reform, obamacare, healthcare, medicare, medicaid, etc.
Exclude: irrelevant content
Examples and boundaries: 1. In interview I told @AP that my taxes are under routine audit and I would release my tax returns when audit is complete, not after election!  | 
2. I am going to repeal and replace ObamaCare. We will have MUCH less expensive and MUCH better healthcare. With Hillary, costs will triple!
themes.Issues related to Military Service and C:
Meaning: Policy issues related to the VA, military action in recent wars, and sharp critique of then-senator McCain.
Include: anything military related or related to McCain
Exclude: irrelevant content, content addressing other senators not related to military
Examples and boundaries: One of the reasons I am no fan of John McCain is that our Vets are being treated so badly by him and the politicians. I will fix VA quickly.
themes.Trump Campaign Merchandise and Book Prom:
Meaning: Viral promotion of his MAGA hats, yard signs, other campaign merch and his books.
Include: any campaign merch or books authored or signed by Trump
Exclude: non-campaign-related products
Examples and boundaries: I am signing copies of my book CRIPPLED AMERICA. Makes a great holiday gift. Order yours now!
themes.Macy's Boycott and Consumer Relations:
Meaning: This is largely a 1-off theme related to a Macy's boycott. Minimally, other retail-related policy and some of his own merchandise promotion.
Include: Generalize to other retail related policy and to other consumer relation events
Exclude: foreign policy, taxes, healthcare... essentially anything not consumer-related
Examples and boundaries: Boycott @Macys, no guts, no glory. Besides, there are far better stores!
themes.Trump's International Golf Resorts and O:
Meaning: 1-off theme related to his specific Scottish Golf Resort that opened during the campaign
Include: Generalize to the promotion of other resorts, hotels, clubs, or Trump brand related.
Exclude: anything not related to Trump brand or Trump property
Examples and boundaries: The opening of Trump Turnberry in Scotland was a big success. Good timing, I was here for BREXIT. Very exciting news conference today!

decision_rule: When multiple themes are present, extrapolate the primary theme by evaluating the proportion of words that could reasonable be attributed to a theme, as well as inspecting the #. Use the residual label when there is nothing closely related. [Added after discussion with Second Researcher: We have concerns about transferability of themes, given that some of them are closely tied to the election itself or a on-off event. When coding the presidential-era content we can be more liberal in classification (e.g., attacking other republicans may stand-in for the republican primary dynamics; his Scottish golf resort may stand-in for later general promotion of any of his hotels or other businesses).
